candidateDataset: mekong_verified_candidates.json, Gemini candidate batch of 178; full original held locally for further review
method: All 100 remaining candidates were screened against current published and held records. Accepted candidates had relevant publisher text and dateline reviewed; summaries were shortened and qualified. Blocked, scanned, mismatched, and geographically ambiguous sources remain unaccepted. Non-English translations require native-language review. Follow-up review checked accessible full texts and metadata, used Thai OCR on scanned documents, and retained unresolved geographic or source ambiguities. The 2017 Lao minerals law was checked through its English text on UN ESCAP.

note: Unresolved candidates remain outside the public archive; duplicate candidates and excluded candidates remain documented for review. Original candidate files are preserved locally.
